prs.title: fix(server): allow JSON Accept in JSON response mode
prs.author: Genmin
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP JSON response mode rejects requests whose Accept header lists only 'application/json' (without also listing 'text/event-stream'), returning a 406 error. Both PRs relax the same validation check in webStandardStreamableHttp.ts so JSON-only Accept headers are accepted. (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP JSON response mode rejects requests whose Accept header lists only 'application/json' (without also listing 'text/event-stream'), returning a 406 error. Both PRs relax the same validation check in webStandardStreamableHttp.ts so JSON-only Accept headers are accepted. (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: Both patch the identical validation block in webStandardStreamableHttp.ts and ship an identical changeset description of the same behavior change, so they are the same fix. #1996 replaces the check with a dedicated acceptsMediaType() helper that does real HTTP content-negotiation parsing (splits on ';' params, honors q=0 to treat an explicitly-excluded media type as rejected, and does type/subtype comparison) rather than a plain substring test. #2046's visible diff swaps the two-header requirement for a simple 'application/json'.includes() check, which is a smaller patch but doesn't account for q=0 exclusion or parameterized Accept values (e.g. 'application/json;q=0' would still incorrectly pass). The more spec-correct parsing in #1996 makes it the safer base to keep; #2046's approach/tests can be merged in if they cover cases #1996 misses.

clusters.pick_reason: Both patch the identical validation block in webStandardStreamableHttp.ts and ship an identical changeset description of the same behavior change, so they are the same fix. #1996 replaces the check with a dedicated acceptsMediaType() helper that does real HTTP content-negotiation parsing (splits on ';' params, honors q=0 to treat an explicitly-excluded media type as rejected, and does type/subtype comparison) rather than a plain substring test. #2046's visible diff swaps the two-header requirement for a simple 'application/json'.includes() check, which is a smaller patch but doesn't account for q=0 exclusion or parameterized Accept values (e.g. 'application/json;q=0' would still incorrectly pass). The more spec-correct parsing in #1996 makes it the safer base to keep; #2046's approach/tests can be merged in if they cover cases #1996 misses.

clusters.pick_reason: Both patch the identical validation block in webStandardStreamableHttp.ts and ship an identical changeset description of the same behavior change, so they are the same fix. #1996 replaces the check with a dedicated acceptsMediaType() helper that does real HTTP content-negotiation parsing (splits on ';' params, honors q=0 to treat an explicitly-excluded media type as rejected, and does type/subtype comparison) rather than a plain substring test. #2046's visible diff swaps the two-header requirement for a simple 'application/json'.includes() check, which is a smaller patch but doesn't account for q=0 exclusion or parameterized Accept values (e.g. 'application/json;q=0' would still incorrectly pass). The more spec-correct parsing in #1996 makes it the safer base to keep; #2046's approach/tests can be merged in if they cover cases #1996 misses.
